title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (prisma) — review required
description: In prisma, await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT ${x}` mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via parameterized $queryRaw or finders.
applicability: prisma data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
